The '''Abominable Weaver''' is an {{MCD|ancient}} {{MCD|Spider|spider}} that can be encountered during an {{MCD|ancient hunt}}. The Abominable Weaver offers, at a minimum, the following runes:

* {{DuMiscSprite|Rune A}}
* {{DuMiscSprite|Rune S}}
* {{DuMiscSprite|Rune T}}

The Abominable Weaver possesses, at minimum, the following {{MCD|Enchanted|enchantments}}:

* {{DuEnchantmentLink|Frenzied}}
* {{DuEnchantmentLink|Mob Resurrection Aura}}
* {{DuEnchantmentLink|Multishot}}
* {{DuEnchantmentLink|Regeneration}}

== Spawning ==
* {{DuLevelLink|Ancient Hunt}}
** {{DuMiscLink|id=Abominable Weaver Ancient Dungeon|Abominable Weaver Ancient Dungeon}}

== Behavior ==
The Abominable Weaver is hostile toward heroes and their companions.

=== Walk ===
The Abominable Weaver flees when an enemy approaches.

=== Strong attack ===
Upon reaching a safe distance from an enemy, the Abominable Weaver fires webs from their abdomens, which freeze their targets.

=== Basic attack ===
Once their target is caught in a web, the Abominable Weaver runs up to them and bites them rapidly.

=== Minion enchantments ===
Eight enchanted {{MCD|creeper}}s act as the Abominable Weaver's minions, possessing the following {{MCD|Enchanted|enchantments}}:

* {{DuEnchantmentLink|Deflect}}
* {{DuEnchantmentLink|Quick}}
